coverageNotes: Basic terminal-operation recognition. Does not test schema authoring, pagination, production throughput, or independent implementation.

questions.context: Using Convex 1.44.0, products contains name: string, price: number, and inStock: boolean. The table fits within query limits. A public query takes no arguments and must return an array of every product, including system fields. Its ctx is in scope.
questions.question: Which handler returns the required array for an empty table as well as a table of any size within those limits?

options.rationale: collect returns the complete array of documents, including system fields; the 0, 1, and 11-row cases pass.
first returns null or one document, not the required array of all documents.
take(10) caps the result at ten and omits the eleventh document.
unique returns null or one document and throws when the table has multiple rows.
